messages:
zoe: quick a11y sweep of the Model Runs details — noticed a couple of small but annoying things: keyboard focus jumps to an offscreen sr-note after Save, badge text contrast dips in dim theme, and pills have no visible focus in the compact list.
maria: thanks. repro steps? which element gets programmatic focus?
zoe: open Run -> Presets -> Edit -> Save. The sr-helper (visually hidden) is receiving focus to trigger narration, so sighted keyboard users lose the visible target.
chris: classic. We should avoid focusing hidden nodes. Use an aria-live region (role=status) for the announcement and programmatically focus a visible row instead.
a11y-bot: checklist: no focus on hidden live nodes; announce via polite aria-live; return focus to updated preset row (tabindex=-1 then focus()); visible focus style on pills; badge contrast >= 4.5:1 for small text.
sam: color note: current badge label is ~3.8:1 in dim; propose bg = --brand-600 + text = #061014 to reach >4.5:1. I'll run the sweep.
maria: also add aria-posinset/aria-setsize to preset items so SR users know "item X of Y". And update CSS to restore focus-visible on .pill (no outline: none).
chris: plan: 1) move announcements into role/status container; 2) stop focusing sr-only helpers; 3) after save, set tabindex=-1 on updated row and call focus(); 4) restore accessible focus styles; 5) swap badge token and add contrast screenshots. PR incoming.
a11y-bot: tests to add: axe baseline, a keyboard e2e asserting focus return, and SR smoke notes for iOS/Android post-merge.
zoe: thanks — small changes but will stop keyboard/sr users from getting lost. :thumbsup:
